title: auspol forecast pipeline
about: What the daily Victorian (and NSW 2027) forecast run does on GitHub Actions, in order, and how long each part takes: from fetching the polls to the forecast and the what-if sliders landing on the release and the data store the site reads. The model's own stages (the forecast's four steps and the rebuild's eight) are described in docs/PIPELINE.md; this file is the GitHub Actions run that executes them every day.

pipelines.name: Daily forecast refresh
pipelines.about: One run per day. The forecast job publishes first; then 16 what-if jobs (4 parties, 2 modes, 2 elections) rerun the seat model with one party's vote forced, side by side, and a last job combines and publishes them. Only full daily runs are counted: the title must say "(daily)" and the what-if jobs must have run. From 25 Nov 2026 every run uses 100,000 simulations (was 20,000), so runs before that date are faster than today's.
pipelines.triggers: The inthegame-blog site's worker dispatches it at 4:30am Melbourne time with daily=true; GitHub's own schedule (17:37 UTC) is a late fallback that the gate job skips when the day's run already went. It starts nothing else: the site reads the files it publishes.

jobs.name: gate
jobs.about: Checks whether today's daily forecast already ran, so a late fallback or a duplicated dispatch does not run it twice

steps.re:^Run go\\(\\): Lists the last 10 runs of this workflow and stops this one if a daily run in the last 12 hours already succeeded or is still going

jobs.name: refresh
jobs.about: The forecast itself: fetches the polls and the trained models, runs every model stage, and publishes Victoria and then NSW 2027 to the release and the data store

steps.Fetch the anchor's poll data: Clones the poll CSVs and seat files from the aus-polling-analyser repository (a shallow copy of its analysis folder only)
steps.Restore cached election results: Restores the past election results (VEC, ECSA, ECQ pages) saved by an earlier run; they never change, so they are fetched only when the fetch scripts change
steps.Fetch election results: Downloads the past election results from the commissions when the cache missed (skipped on a cache hit)
steps.Cache election results: Saves the election results just fetched for later runs (skipped on a cache hit)
steps.Fetch the trained models: Downloads the trained trees and the fitted tables from the shipped-models release; refetches today's Wikipedia and Poll Bludger poll tables and leader ratings; fails if any required file is missing or the models are more than 14 days old
steps.Refuse zero-byte inputs: Stops the run if any poll file, election result or downloaded model is an empty file
steps.Run the pipeline: Runs scripts/run_all.R: every model stage from preference flows to the seat simulation and the pages (stages in the next table); then checks the Victorian outputs were written by this run
steps.Summarise: Writes the headline numbers, every check line and the warnings to the run's summary page
steps.Publish the forecast to the forecast-lat: Uploads the Victorian forecast files and a poll snapshot to the forecast-latest release, then builds the all-primaries what-if simulations and the upper-house forecast
steps.Publish the forecast to R2 for the ITG p: Copies the forecast, page data, what-if, upper-house, pollster and party files to the R2 store the site reads
steps.Keep a dated copy of the forecast on R2: Saves today's forecast under a dated name on R2, so past days can be shown (scripts/publish_forecast_history.sh)
steps.re:^NSW 2027 forecast: Downloads the NSW tables, runs the seat model for NSW 2027 at 20,000 simulations, builds its forecast JSON and poll-trend data, and uploads them to the release
steps.Publish the NSW 2027 forecast to R2 for: Copies the NSW 2027 forecast files to R2
steps.Keep a dated copy of the NSW 2027 foreca: Saves today's NSW 2027 forecast under a dated name on R2
steps.Upload outputs: Keeps the page, page data, projection mix and the run log as a downloadable bundle for 30 days
steps.Hand the scenario jobs their inputs: Saves everything this job fetched and built so the 16 what-if jobs can start from it
steps.Raise an alarm: On a daily run, opens or updates one tracking issue when a check fails with something new; otherwise writes "Alarm not raised"

stage_notes.the stages of run_all.R: Each stage runs from its `--- name ---` header line to the next one; the last runs to the end of the step.

jobs.name: scenarios
jobs.about: The what-if slider: 16 copies, one per election, party and mode ("exactly X%" or "polling at X%"); each reruns the seat model at 9 forced vote levels

steps.Release the dpkg lock the timed-out R se: Only when the R install timed out: frees the package-manager lock before the retry
steps.Release the dpkg lock the timed-out depe: Only when the package install timed out: frees the package-manager lock before the retry
steps.Say when an R install step needed its re: Only after a retry: says so in the run's warnings
steps.Run this copy's scenarios: Runs scripts/build_scenarios.R for this copy's election, party and mode: the seat model at each forced vote level

jobs.name: publish-scenarios
jobs.about: Joins the 16 copies' results into one what-if file per election and publishes it

steps.Combine into scenario-<election>.json: Runs scripts/combine_scenarios.py (Python, no R install) to build scenario-vic2026.json and scenario-nsw2027.json
steps.Publish to the forecast-latest release a: Uploads the what-if files to the forecast-latest release and to R2

jobs.name: scenario-alarm
jobs.about: Only when a what-if job failed on a daily run: opens or updates the tracking issue
